description: This PHP source file defines the OptionalFieldAPI class, which provides API endpoints for retrieving and updating configuration related to optional fields in a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods to get current settings, validate inputs, and save updated configurations, with support for OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: OptionalFieldAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for getting and updating optional fields configuration, with integrated validation and configuration persistence.
